header.description: What: CE-4649 (bows BW-4) - on bt-range an Archer (Friend, 29,10) is ordered to shoot 5 arrows at a point on the brick wall (25..33, y 40) 30 m north (29,39.8, 1.2 m up). Each arrow STOPS in the wall and STICKS there: it freezes with its rotation along its flight, its point a third of its length in, and lies 600 s (the rail BallisticsSystemTests.CE4649 proves the pose; a rail proves the 257th lying round removes the oldest). Judge: at least 3 arrows end StoppedByTerrain. Fail: no arrow reaches the wall (refused or short), or they vanish. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh bw-stuck-wall
